mapper.select: SELECT notification_id::TEXT AS row_id, type, content, link_url, read_yn, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM notification WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY notification_id DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND member_id = #{memberId} AND read_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (member_id, type, content, link_url, read_yn, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, 'N', 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_yn = 'Y', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE notification_id = #{rowId}::integer AND member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE notification SET read_yn = 'Y', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND read_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(s.apply_yn, 'Y') AS apply_yn, COALESCE(s.comment_yn, 'Y') AS comment_yn, COALESCE(s.message_yn, 'Y') AS message_yn, COALESCE(s.review_yn, 'Y') AS review_yn FROM (SELECT 1) d LEFT JOIN notification_setting s ON s.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_setting (member_id, apply_yn, comment_yn, message_yn, review_yn, upd_dt) VALUES (#{memberId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{applyYn}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{commentYn}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{messageYn}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{reviewYn}, ''), 'Y'), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET apply_yn = EXCLUDED.apply_yn, comment_yn = EXCLUDED.comment_yn, message_yn = EXCLUDED.message_yn, review_yn = EXCLUDED.review_yn, upd_dt = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, nickname FROM member WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND status_cd = 'STATUS01' AND nickname IS NOT NULL AND nickname IN #{nm}
